title: Danila's surviving update
description: This mod adds to minecraft a lot of items to give you survive! This mod will make youe adventure easier. This is my first project. I make it on MCreator
body: This mod is aimed at beginners, or those playing on a difficult mode. This mod adds a bunch of items and crafts. Namely: Recipes for chainmail armor, totem of immortality, enchanted apple, and cobblestone have been added. Added Items: Amethyst Extract, Copper Scissors, Glass Sword, Lava Sword, Flint Pickaxe, Cooked Glowing Berries, Acorns, Pebbles, Coconut, Stone on a Stick, and Split Coconut. There will also be more items and extras added in the future.
